answer: Agents earn a saffron token only by completing verifiable work epochs, and each identity must stake a bond that is slashed if peers flag duplicate behavior. A new agent can wander freely but cannot vote or claim rewards until it accumulates a history of attested tasks. A rotating beacon assigns challenge audits to random peers, so faking many identities costs real stake per sybil and repeated slashing outpaces any reward from duplication. Agent sa0035 validates this against replay at AsgYNNMfdG.
